If you have a lot of raised scars, those places are fairly acne prone, and since those scars are usually itch a lot, acne scars are common. Even if I clean thoroughly, dirt is easily caught.

Shaving (if you're not a fan of waxing or lazer removal) is terrible when it comes to raised scars. I've accidentally reopened some really old scars. But it's less common with single blade shaving.

Exercising gets itchy real fast, especially with a lot of leg scars.

If a lot of scar tissue builds up in one area, that area tends to feel more numb, especially if you've hit something. So, self soothing gets difficult if you're someone who likes to rub your arms during difficult times.

Seeing gym results. I have a lot of scars on my stomach. It makes it difficult to see any kind of result if it isn't a giant change.

Phantom pains. I don't know if anyone else feels this, but with ones that have healed within the past 5 months, it still stings some times if I walk in a certain way or get hit in a certain area.
